user.title: Choose the gateway
user.description: The bot listens on one private channel of this Meshtastic gateway and answers on the same channel. Add the integration again for another channel.

channel.title: Channel and senders
channel.description: Everyone who has the key of the channel can give the bot commands, so use a channel of its own. The primary channel and channels with the default key cannot be used. Not offered: {unavailable}.

data_description.channel_index: A private channel of the gateway. When the gateway cannot tell about its channels, enter the channel number (1 to 7) and make sure it is private.
data_description.allowed_senders: Nodes that may use the bot. Leave empty to let everyone on the channel ask questions. Required as soon as the bot may control something. A node that is not listed can be typed as !a1b2c3d4.

uplink.title: MQTT uplink is on
uplink.description: The gateway passes the messages of this channel on to an MQTT server. The answers of the bot, for example the temperature of a room, can then leave your house over the internet. Continue only if that is fine.

error.invalid_sender: Enter a node like !a1b2c3d4 or a node number.

abort.already_configured: The bot is already set up on this channel.
abort.no_gateway: Set up the Meshtastic integration with a gateway first.
abort.no_private_channel: The gateway has no private channel. Add a secondary channel with a key of its own to the gateway first. Not usable: {unavailable}.

init.title: What the bot may do
init.description: Everything is refused until it is on a list. A command involving anything outside the lists is answered with 'not allowed'. Both lists only reach what is also exposed to Assist.

data_description.trigger: What a message must start with, for example @habot. The answers start with the same name.
data_description.allowed_senders: Nodes that may use the bot. Leave empty to let everyone on the channel ask questions. Required as soon as the bot may control something or run scripts.
data_description.read_entities: Questions about these entities are answered. Asking for several things at once needs all of them on the list.
data_description.read_areas: Questions about anything in these areas are answered.
data_description.read_domains: Questions about anything of these kinds, for example weather, are answered.
data_description.control_areas: Commands may change anything in these areas, except sensitive devices.
data_description.control_domains: Commands may change anything of these kinds.
data_description.scripts: Scripts that a 'run' command may start, for example '@habot run night mode'. They are found by name.
data_description.allow_sensitive_domains: Lets locks, alarm panels, covers, sirens, valves and climate devices be added to the control list. The built-in agent understands 'turn off' on a lock as unlock and 'turn on' on a cover as open.
data_description.cooldown: Seconds a sender has to wait between two commands. Commands sent sooner get no answer.
data_description.max_answers_per_hour: For the whole bot. More commands get no answer until the hour has passed.
data_description.answer_length: Bytes of one answer, the name of the bot included. Never more than Mesh Chat allows (200).

error.invalid_sender: Enter a node like !a1b2c3d4 or a node number.
error.invalid_trigger: The trigger word must be 2 to 20 characters without spaces, letters and signs only.
error.senders_required: Choose who may use the bot first: controlling things and running scripts needs a list of allowed senders.
error.sensitive_not_allowed: Locks, alarm panels, covers, sirens, valves and climate devices need 'Allow sensitive domains' to be switched on.
